user.title: Connect to Price Buddy
user.description: Connect to the Price Buddy REST API. The application URL and a URL ending in /api are both accepted.

data_description.api_token: Create a token in the Price Buddy user menu and grant permission to list/read products.
data_description.currency: Three-letter currency code used when detailed store currency is unavailable, for example EUR.
data_description.include_details: Adds store, stock, URL and trend attributes. This transfers more data because Price Buddy includes price history in its full response.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Price Buddy credentials
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new Price Buddy API token.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Price Buddy.
error.insufficient_permissions: The API token cannot list products. Grant it product read/list permission.
error.invalid_response: The server did not return a compatible Price Buddy API response.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
error.invalid_currency: Enter a three-letter currency code, for example EUR.

abort.already_configured: This Price Buddy account is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The API token was updated successfully.

data_description.currency: Three-letter fallback currency code, for example EUR.
data_description.include_details: Adds store, stock, URL and trend attributes at the cost of a larger API response.

error.invalid_currency: Enter a three-letter currency code, for example EUR.
